elements.name: b-facts
elements.text:
Every branch is mapped to B's canvas grid by a bilinear resample with align_corners = False, then unit-normalised per position.
The distance is 1 − cosine for every branch, including D; no branch uses a scaled squared Euclidean norm.
The BTAD-03 canvas is 32 × 42 rather than square, so that unit uses the coordinate-correct C re-grid.
